subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should the A2UI dashboard bridge be sequenced behind the browser Canvas action-ingress contract, or should dashboard define its own action path now?
rationale: The issue crosses product direction and a security boundary: sandboxed widgets would route user actions through trusted dashboard/Gateway code, and the canonical browser Canvas action-ingress issue is still open.

options.title: Sequence Behind Canvas Ingress
options.body: Keep this issue open and require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 to define the browser/embedded action sink before dashboard adapts it.

options.title: Define Dashboard Bridge First
options.body: Let the dashboard plugin own a bridge-specific A2UI action path now, accepting the risk of later reconciliation with Canvas web ingress.

options.title: Move To External Plugin Direction
options.body: If bundled dashboard convergence is not current product direction, route the bridge to an external plugin/API discussion after the needed seams exist.

recommendation.title: Sequence Behind Canvas Ingress
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 to define the browser/embedded action sink before dashboard adapts it.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current routing signal for adjacent web-widget product direction and the bundled plugin-tab precedent.
